headlines.title: Coca-Cola’s KFC Win Is About More Than Soda
headlines.summary: Coca-Cola’s KFC agreement adds little to revenue, but shows how marketing, exclusive drinks, and technology can help win restaurant accounts.

headlines.title: If You Invest $200 a Month in Coca-Cola (KO) Stock, Here's the Dividend Income It Could Generate Over 10 Years.
headlines.summary: A modest monthly investment in Coca-Cola can deliver impressive compound gains.

headlines.title: Warren Buffett Has Held Coca-Cola for Decades. Here’s What $1,000 in the Stock Since 1999 Is Worth Today
headlines.summary: Berkshire Hathaway has held Coca-Cola since the late 1980s, but what happened to an ordinary investor who bought in at the turn of the millennium tells a more complicated story about patience, timing, and whether the stock still has room to run.

headlines.title: Is KFC Drink Deal Altering The Investment Case For Coca Cola (KO)?
headlines.summary: KFC U.S. announced it will shift its domestic beverage partnership to Coca-Cola starting in January 2027, with Coca-Cola drinks expected in all U.S. restaurants by spring 2027 as part of KFC's broader menu and beverage refresh. This win over PepsiCo gives Coca-Cola broader fountain exposure across roughly 3,700 to 4,000 KFC locations, deepening its foodservice reach and creating more occasions for consumers to choose its portfolio when eating out.

headlines.title: 5 Dividend Stocks for Investors Who Want Income Without the Market’s Wild Swings
headlines.summary: Soda, toothpaste, phone service, electricity, and prescription drugs all share one trait: people keep buying them when the economy turns ugly. Five companies built their businesses around that reality, and the way they protect their dividends says more than the yield numbers do.

description: The Coca-Cola Company, a beverage company, manufactures and sells various nonalcoholic beverages in the United States and internationally. The company provides Trademark Coca-Cola, sparkling soft drinks and flavors; water, sports, coffee, and tea; juice, value-added dairy, and plant-based beverages; and emerging beverages. It also offers beverage concentrates and syrups, as well as fountain syrups to fountain retailers comprising restaurants and convenience stores. The company sells its products under the Coca-Cola, Diet Coke/Coca-Cola Light, Coca-Cola Zero Sugar, caffeine free Diet Coke, Cherry Coke, Fanta, Sprite, Simply, Fanta Orange, Fanta Zero Orange, Fanta Zero Sugar, Fanta Apple, Sprite Zero Sugar, Simply Orange, Simply Apple, Simply Grapefruit, Fresca, Schweppes, Thums Up, Aquarius, Ayataka, BODYARMOR, Ciel, Costa, Crystal, Dasani, Fuze Tea, Georgia, glacéau smartwater, glacéau vitaminwater, Gold Peak, I LOHAS, Powerade, Topo Chico, Core Power, Del Valle, fairlife, innocent, Maaza, Minute Maid, Minute Maid Pulpy, Santa Clara, and dogadan brands. It operates through a network of independent bottling partners, distributors, wholesalers, and retailers, as well as through bottling and distribution operators. The Coca-Cola Company was founded in 1886 and is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia.
